programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: A father goes undercover and infiltrates a Mexican drug cartel for the DEA in order to free his son.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on Earth.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by an elite task force official to aid in the escalating war against drugs

programme.title: A Family Man
programme.desc: From the Writer of The Accountant and Ozark comes an unforgettably moving drama with an all-star cast featuring Gerard Butler, Gretchen Mol, and Willem Dafoe. A head-hunter, desperate to climb to the top of the corporate ladder, grows distant from his family as his life increasingly revolves around closing deals in a survival-of-the-fittest boiler room. But these dreams suddenly grind to a halt when his son is diagnosed with a life-threatening illness.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: A brilliantly hilarious "in tents" comedy drama, starring David Arquette, Amy Acker and Academy Award nominee June Squibb. With their marriage on the rocks, Jack and Amanda head off on a glamping trip to "reignite their spark". But when their blissful romantic getaway is hijacked by a pair of hipster honeymooners and a hunky land-owner, they are left in more trouble than before!

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: A highly-compelling political thriller from award-winning director Agniezka Holland. Welsh journalist Gareth Jones (James Norton: Little Women) risks his life to expose the truth about the devastating famine in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. Also starring Vanessa Kirby (The Crown) and Golden Globe Nominee Peter Sarsgaard (The Batman). This is the most important true story you will ever see.

programme.title: Assassin
programme.desc: Danny Dyer (Eastenders) is back on top form in Assassin, a brutal, hard-hitting story of Jamie, a former hitman out for revenge. Starring Martin Kemp (The Krays), Gary Kemp (The World's End), and from the producers of Rise of the Footsoldier and Goodfellas, Assassin is the story of the most corrupt crime bosses in the London underworld, and one man's crusade to bring them to justice.

programme.title: The Contender
programme.desc: This Oscar nominated political White House thriller stars Gary Oldman, Jeff Bridges, Sam Elliot, Christian Slater and Joan Allen. We follow a senior Senator, who is contending for the US Vice Presidency and her fall from grace after accusations about her past surface. Described as a modern political masterpiece and a flawless thriller that educates and entertains all at the same time.

programme.title: You Had Me at Aloha
programme.desc: (2021) Sun-soaked romance starring Pascale Hutton and Kavan Smith. The network sees their chemistry, but is love on the cue cards when two clashing co-hosts team up on a travel show in Hawaii?

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: (2016) Romantic comedy starring Rachael Leigh Cook. A widowed mum enters the tech world, where love and coding crash into each other, creating the perfect romantic connection.

programme.title: Romance at the Vineyard
programme.desc: (2023) Sparkling romance with Susie Abromeit. As Allee tries to save her family's struggling vineyard, a charming stranger steps in to help. But will feelings turn sour when his identity is uncorked?

programme.title: Romance in Hawaii
programme.desc: (2023) Sun-drenched romance with Kelley Jakle and Cedric Jonathan. When high-flying executive Leah discovers the art of hula in Hawaii, will she be saying aloha to what's missing in her life?

programme.title: Falling for the Manny
programme.desc: (2022) Romance starring Elisabeth Harnois and Tyler Johnson. Keen to impress at her firm's family retreat, can single mum Alice become partner, bond with her daughter and land her dream man(ny)?

programme.title: Vita & Virginia
programme.desc: It's the fascinating true story about the love affair between socialite and popular author Vita Sackville-West and literary icon Virginia Woolf, and the love story that inspired Virginia Woolf's Orlando. Starring Gemma Arterton, Elizabeth Debicki and Isabella Rossellini.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

programme.title: The Sun is Also a Star
programme.desc: “What if I told you I could get you to fall in love with me…?” College-bound romantic Daniel Bae (Melton) and Jamaica-born pragmatist Natasha Kingsley (Shahidi) meet—and fall for each other—over one magical day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City...

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: Coffee Shop
programme.desc: A small-town coffee shop owner's romance with a struggling playwright from New York is threatened when her shop goes into foreclosure and her ex-boyfriend returns to town to save it.

programme.title: Groomzilla
programme.desc: A woman is surprised and dismayed when her fiance takes the planning of their wedding too seriously.

programme.title: Forever In My Heart
programme.desc: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs—back home or in the Emerald Isle.

programme.title: Game Of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: Prescription For Love
programme.desc: Claire, a nurse, fights for a chance at love with a charming new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail Claire's chance at happiness, Claire will have to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: Island of Grace
programme.desc: For Megan, matters of faith are to be hidden from her friends and coworkers. Her social life and the way she wants to live come first. But when she goes on a business trip with two coworkers- the arrogant office crush Mark, and the office nobody, Chris-her plane crashes, and she's forced to reexamine her life. Stranded on an island in a far corner of the world, Megan begins a journey not just of survival, but discovering herself and what really matters.

programme.title: Love's Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: After The Storm
programme.desc: Lauren wants to rebuild her community, including her family home, in the aftermath of a devastatingly disastrous storm.

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: A Gift Wrapped Christmas
programme.desc: Personal shopper Gwen's new client Charlie is a workaholic.

programme.title: A Very Merry Toy Store
programme.desc: Connie and Will, like their families before them, have been business rivals.

programme.title: My Christmas Grandpa
programme.desc: Girl requests cashier as grandpa for Christmas Vivica A. Fox, Bill Cobbs star.

programme.title: Random Acts of Christmas
programme.desc: Investigative journalist, Sydney, meets a competing reporter, Cole.

programme.title: What Did Jesus Eat at His Last Supper?
programme.desc: Sohla recreates what is believed to be Jesus and his disciples iconic last supper.

programme.title: A Gift Wrapped Christmas
programme.desc: Personal shopper Gwen's new client Charlie is a workaholic.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding
programme.desc: Haley, staunchly anti-marriage, tries on her grandma's magical veil and sees her future with boyfriend Scott.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it's too late.

programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

programme.title: Funny Lady
programme.desc: FUNNY LADY resumes several years after FUNNY GIRL and chronicles Fanny Brice's relationship--both personal and professional--with second husband, showman Billy Rose.

programme.title: Eat Pray Love
programme.desc: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) travels to discover meaning & happiness in this inspiring true story.

programme.title: As Good As It Gets
programme.desc: The Academy Award-winning (best actor Jack Nicholson, best actress Helen Hunt) offbeat comedy celebrates the unique bond between three very different characters. Also stars Greg Kinnear.

programme.title: As Good As It Gets
programme.desc: The Academy Award-winning (best actor Jack Nicholson, best actress Helen Hunt) offbeat comedy celebrates the unique bond between three very different characters. Also stars Greg Kinnear.

programme.desc: Pat O'Brien, also known as Django, flees Texas after being accused of murdering his wife and joins the Mexican army under General Camargo. While protecting territory from bandits, he becomes entangled with a wealthy landowning family and is soon accused of another murder, deepening the web of betrayal and danger around him.

programme.desc: After living for decades among the Sioux as “Man Called Horse,” Englishman John Morgan faces growing tensions when gold is discovered in the Black Hills, sacred Sioux land protected by treaty. As settlers and provocateurs push toward war, Morgan's son Koda and Red Wing fight to defend their people and preserve the land.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: In Tulsa, after a rancher dies during a feud with a major oil company, his daughter, driven by revenge, starts digging for oil herself.

Heather Graham also stars.

programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: Banker Martin Raikes heads to Monaco to investigate strange financial activity surrounding a film production that his bank is financing. There he encounters the film's star, the washed-up, hard-drinking one-time action star Jake Mellows. Before he can conduct a thorough investigation, Raikes finds himself framed for the assassination of a government official. With both crooks and the law out to get him, Raikes goes on the run, eventually hooking up with Mellows.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Two estranged sisters are forced to rob a bank in order to save their brother. The heist begins smoothly, but mayhem ensues when the defiant bank manager sends them to a basement-level vault.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Freeway [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crazed driver with a deeply troubled past goes on a nightly shooting spree across the highways of America.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: The violent impulses of Bob Malone (Michael Rooker), a former Los Angeles policeman forced to leave his job in disgrace, get the better of him during a bank robbery, and he wipes out nearly all the robbers. Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: La demoiselle d'honneur
programme.desc: Une voyante dit à Charlotte qu'elle est destinée à être avec Rory lorsqu'il reviendra de voyage, mais il rentre au pays avec une fiancée.

programme.title: La liste du bonheur
programme.desc: Hazel souhaite promouvoir sa nouvelle boîte d'abonnement lors d'une émission, mais devient trop nerveuse pour le faire correctement.

programme.title: La recette de l'amour
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de son nouveau voisin, une chef découvre que ses affaires peuvent prospérer, avec un peu d'effort et de confiance.

programme.title: La soeur de trop
programme.desc: Les jumelles Reina et Alex voient leur vie bouleversée par leur sœur Trinity, qui a été séparée d'elles à la naissance.

programme.title: La vérité sur ma naissance
programme.desc: Lors de la fête d'anniversaire de 16 ans de Rachel Collins, un meurtre est commis et un tissu de mensonges familiaux est révélé.

programme.title: Autumn Leaves
programme.desc: A middle aged woman's romance with a man half her age becomes a nightmare when his past comes to haunt them.

programme.title: The Silencers
programme.desc: An organization wants to sabatoge the American atomic missile system.

programme.title: Don't Raise The Bridge, Lower The River

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story

programme.title: Charlie Parker
programme.desc: The documentary The Story of Jazz is a seamless array of performances, commentary, and compelling historic insights about jazz, zooming in on the cross-cultural influences that produced this constantly evolving and enduring music. Many call jazz the greatest art form of the 20th century. This absorbing weave of sounds, rare film clips, stills and interviews shows how this truly American expression spread to become a universal, musical language, from the New Orleans traditions, stride, swing, boogie woogie, big band, jump band, blues, bebop, Afro-Cuban, cool, and free-form, to jazz vocalists and dancers… Never before have the filmed comments of so many important great jazz artists been assembled for one project, and never before has the history of jazz been told as vividly and with such attention to historic detail.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Melody Gardot, Charles Staab, Sam Minaie & Mitchell Long
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I'm a Fool' and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine' and ‘Les Étoiles,' before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don't Know What Love Is.' Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: John Coltrane, McCoy Tyner, Elvin Jones & Jimmy Garrison
programme.desc: The mere mention of the name John Coltrane evokes a deeply emotional, often spiritual response from even the most casual jazz fan. Dexter Gordon was a fantastic saxophonist. Miles Davis was a genius. Coltrane stood above - he was a visionary, a saint-like figure. By the standards of most jazz musicians, his life was uneventful. Sure, he had a heroin habit for a while, and Miles Davis punched him, but once he'd experienced the “spiritual awakening” described in the liner notes of his 1965 album A Love Supreme, he dedicated himself to his music with extreme single-mindedness. This broadcast of Coltrane's 1965 performance at the short-lived Belgian jazz festival in Comblain-la-Tour features Trane's classic quartet with Elvin Jones (drums), Jimmy Garrison (bass) and McCoy Tyner (piano).

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Glass Marcano, Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours & Stéphanie-Marie Degand
programme.sub-title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. This piece is one of the most important works in its genre. The program concludes with Georges Bizet's 1855 Symphony in C major, written when the composer was only 17 years old.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: The Everly Brothers
programme.desc: When asked recently for the most memorable moment of his career, Phil Everly replied 'the Albert Hall reunion'. It was September 1983, and ten years on from one of the most acrimonious splits in popular music history, when the Everly Brothers, Don and Phil, took to the stage at London's Royal Albert Hall. The Everlys had dominated the charts in the late fifties and early to mid sixties. Their close harmony singing, acoustic guitars and brilliant songwriting had become instantly recognisable and inspired millions of fans worldwide. On an emotional night in London, the reunion was a success and led to the renewal of their partnership and many more years of success, which continue to this day. Bonus Features: 'Rock 'n' Roll Odyssey' - this documentary, made at the same time as the Albert Hall reunion, tells the complete story of the Everly Brothers up to that point in time. Don and Phil tell their story with additional contributions from Linda Ronstadt, Chet Atkins and many more.

programme.title: Heart
programme.sub-title: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra. Live At The Royal Albert Hall With The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra includes chart-topping songs like “These Dreams”, “Alone”, “What About Love”, “Barracuda”, “Magic Man”, “Dreamboat Annie”, and more!

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: The Beach Boys
programme.desc: The Beach Boys special is a rockumentary which explores the life of the Beach Boys as camera and crews follow them across the United States on their Good Vibrations Tour. It includes live performances of the Beach Boys' greatest hits such as 'Surfin USA' or 'Good Vibrations'.

Experience timeless tunes 'Tennessee River', 'Love In The First Degree', 'I'm In A Hurry (And Don't Know Why)', 'My Home's In Alabama', and more.

programme.desc: Transport your senses to the rugged yet exquisitely beautiful Big Sur coast of California to relax & absorb the healing sights and sounds of McWay Falls from a unique and rare perspective. Filmed more than a decade ago and remastered for maximum color and quality, "A Day in Big Sur" showcases the timeless beauty of this magical destination and attempts to truly capture the spirit of this natural paradise through the use of 50+ artistically framed video perspectives - all featuring real stereo nature sounds for an immersive relaxation experience.

programme.title: Whispers of the Wilderness

programme.title: Diamond Beach I: Indonesia (Music)

programme.title: Above the Fiji Islands II 1
programme.desc: In Above the Fiji Islands 2, viewers will gracefully soar over some of the most majestic and remote islands in the South Pacific - paired with stereo real-life nature sounds and soothing signature ambient music by Relax Moods. With a dynamic mix of perspectives both from the ground level & a bird's eye view, and through the use of extra smooth & slow continuous shots, this film is sure to help anyone forget all of their worries! At the end of the film, there is a beautiful real-time sunset so viewers can enjoy watching the sun as it sinks into the sea...

programme.title: Fly Over Indonesia 1 (Music)

programme.title: A Day in Santorini

programme.desc: Sarah es una pintora sin inspiración, soltera, tiene mala suerte y quiere escapar de sus problemas. Decide visitar a su madre, y se involucra en salvar una iglesia local que está en peligro de cerrar.

programme.title: Navidad en el Majestic
programme.desc: Nell es una arquitecta que tiene el encargo de transformar el histórico Majestic Playhouse de Briar Falls, su ciudad natal, en un gran y moderno complejo. Ella acepta a regañadientes, ya que es un edificio emblemático donde se exponen los cuadros navideños, una tradición de la localidad. Su tarea se complica cuando conoce a Connor, el nuevo dueño del teatro, con una mentalidad muy distinta a la suya. Nell confía en que si lo acompaña durante el Twelve Day Festival, Connor cambie de opinión sobre la modernización del Majestic.

programme.title: Ya Llega la Navidad
programme.desc: Claire, una inversora de riesgo de Nueva York, se escapa a una pintoresca ciudad de Vermont durante las vacaciones de Navidad. A su llegada, Claire descubre que las celebraciones navideñas han sido canceladas en la ciudad después de una inundación y la librería del pueblo se encuentra en un estado lamentable.

programme.title: Creep
programme.desc: Londres. Una fría noche invernal, Kate va a coger el metro pero, mientras espera en un banco del andén, se queda dormida. Cuando se despierta, todo el mundo ha desaparecido.

programme.title: La anguila
programme.desc: Después de ocho años en la cárcel por haber matado a su esposa por infiel, Takuro Yamashita sale en libertad condicional. Su mascota y única compañera es una anguila. Yamashita se establece en una pequeña población a las afueras de Tokio y regenta una barbería, presidida por un acuario en el que nada su anguila. Un día conoce a Keiko Hattori, una joven que intenta suicidarse y que le recuerda a su esposa. Poco a poco se van conociendo y terminan enamorándose.

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Constance es una chica a la que le gusta leer. La lectura es para ella fantasía, sueño, imagen de un mundo irrealizable pero bello. Leyendo la novela «La lectora» se identifica con María, su protagonista. Una y otra, en la realidad y en la ficción, irán descubriendo los sabores de la vida. Cada palabra es un goce, un paso profundo en el conocimiento, en los placeres de la libertad y la belleza. Provocación, encanto, placer, deseo, perversidad e inocencia... mucho más que simple erotismo.

programme.title: Punto de no retorno
programme.desc: Un científico roba la tecnología de un experimento secreto para viajar en el tiempo.

programme.title: Noche de paz, noche de muerte

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: En Compañía de Lobos
programme.desc: Lobos y criaturas fantásticas acechan los sueños de la joven Rosaleen, quien sueña que debe atravesar el bosque oscuro para llegar a casa de su abuela.

programme.title: El Lute: Camina o Revienta
programme.desc: En 1960, una familia de quinquis recorre Extremadura. La vida tan dura que llevan causa la muerte de la madre. El hijo, Eleuterio Sánchez, roba unas gallinas y es condenado a seis meses de cárcel...

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: Imparable
programme.desc: Un exgánster intenta vivir en paz, pero tras el secuestro de su esposa, retoma la violencia para salvarla.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo

programme.title: Operación Lobo
programme.desc: Versión cinematográfica de la serie Netflix: una unidad policial combate para frenar un golpe de Estado.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: La Perfecta Desconocida
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre contempla mudarse a un nuevo estado con su esposa para su programa de posgrado, un viejo amor, una mujer que a menudo cambia de identidad, regresa a su vida en una cena de cumpleaños.

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: Contra
programme.desc: El profesor Richard Pohl se hace viral tras un comentario xenófobo en clase: insulta a Naima Hamid, estudiante de Derecho, delante de todos sus compañeros.

programme.title: Más allá de la verdad
programme.desc: Una joven sorprende a la familia de su difunto novio al contarles que está embarazada de un hijo suyo.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo y dos adorables hijos.

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Vega conoce a alguien que devolverá el color a su vida.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan a la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: A Wedding to Remember
programme.desc: En lados opuestos de un proyecto de desarrollo, Olivia y Brian se sorprenden al descubrir que son la dama de honor y el padrino de la misma boda. Han dejado a un lado sus sentimientos para salvar la boda de sus mejores amigos... ¡que puede acabar convirtiéndose también en la suya!

programme.title: Dulce como el amor
programme.desc: Jessie Dale es la tercera generación de panaderos y ama su pastelería más que a nada en el mundo. Unos desarrolladores amenazan con comprar el edificio y obligarla a irse, por lo que se ve en la obligación de hacer todo lo posible para salvar la panadería.

programme.title: En el amor todo vale
programme.desc: Una compañía teatral lleva años trabajando en una feria que recrea el mundo renacentista, pero un día el propietario amenaza con despedirlos y contratar los servicios de una compañía rival.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: Byzantium
programme.desc: En la orilla de un pueblo costero desolado se encuentra el hotel Byzantium. Después de años de abandono, sus puertas están a punto de ser abiertas de nuevo por la depredadora y seductora Clara, que planea convertir el hotel en un burdel, y su joven e introvertida hija Eleanor. Dos misteriosas mujeres que esconden un oscuro secreto que se remonta 200 años atrás y que está a punto de llegar a un clímax mortal.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: La esposa de un exsheriff de Arizona es asesinada en su rancho. Al parecer, la culpa es de un mexicano que ha cruzado ilegalmen…

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: Oscar Wilde es brillante y egocéntrico, genio y poeta, único en su especie y el primer hombre moderno. En el periodo de mayor creatividad de su carrera, en el que escribe algunas de sus obras más conocidas, Wilde asume su homosexualidad, lo que le supone el terrible tormento de tener que conjugar su matrimonio y sus responsabilidades como padre con el amor obsesivo que siente por Lord Alfred Douglas, un joven con el que entabla una apasionada y turbulenta relación.

programme.title: El cielo protector
programme.desc: 1947. Una pareja de neoyorquinos viaja a África en busca de nuevas experiencias que puedan dar un nuevo sentido a su relación. En compañía de un joven y rico compañero de viaje, George Tunner, se adentran en el Sáhara en busca de un lugar del que han oído contar cierta leyenda árabe. A medida que huyen de sí mismos y de la civilización, se producen misteriosos acontecimientos que cambiarán sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Martín Circo Martín, acaba de convertirse en el ganador del mayor premio de la historia de la televisión.

programme.title: El Partido Repartido
programme.desc: Bryan, un ambicioso joven político, conoce a Serena, una poderosa mujer dentro del partido político.

programme.title: Súper Papá
programme.desc: Un padre viudo con seis hijos, sostiene una batalla legal con sus suegros por la custodia de los niños.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Cuando Minnesota West salva al joven Silver, el chico lo lleva a Holysand, una ciudad al borde del caos.

programme.title: Juntos Para Vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado fantasea con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Cameron Crowe ('Casi famosos') nos presenta la historia de un ingeniero espacial (Bradley Cooper) que regresa a su hogar. Allí acepta trabajar con una piloto (Emma Stone) que le ayudará a descubrir una mejor versión de sí mismo.

programme.title: Mi querido dictador
programme.desc: Tatiana Mills una estudiante estadounidense de 16 años escribe, como trabajo de clase, una carta a Anton Vincent, un notorio dictador de una nación isleña del Caribe. Tras siglos de opresión los habitantes de la isla se rebelan finalmente contra la dictadura y Anton es derrocado por su propio pueblo

programme.title: In the Loop
programme.desc: El Presidente de EE.UU. y el Primer Ministro británico deciden iniciar una guerra y prometen ser rápidos. El Secretario de Estado británico para el desarrollo internacional, respalda accidentalmente la acción militar en horario de máxima audiencia en televisión, ganando muchos amigos en Washington.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: El Profe
programme.desc: Un joven profesor llega a una pequeña ciudad, pero descubre que hay gente que no lo quiere allí.

programme.title: Su Excelencia
programme.desc: Cantinflas trabaja en la embajada de Los Cocos repartiendo visados a todos los que desean visitar su país natal. En este momento el mundo está dividido en dos: los países rojos y los países verdes. Ambos bloques están igualados en fuerzas y la república de Los Cocos posee el voto definitivo. Por una serie de circunstancias, Cantinflas se convierte en el embajador.

programme.title: El Señor Doctor
programme.desc: Cantinflas interpreta a un médico de pueblo que quiere viajar a la gran ciudad para aprender las nuevas tecnologías. Pero nada más llegar, Cantinflas pone patas arriba el hospital con su mentalidad pueblerina y se enamora de la hermana de su supervisor, quien cree que Cantinflas está demasiado anticuado.

programme.title: El Señor Doctor
programme.desc: Cantinflas interpreta a un médico de pueblo que quiere viajar a la gran ciudad para aprender las nuevas tecnologías. Pero nada más llegar, Cantinflas pone patas arriba el hospital con su mentalidad pueblerina y se enamora de la hermana de su supervisor, quien cree que Cantinflas está demasiado anticuado.

programme.title: Al oeste de la división
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters de Gentry y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace tiempo.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 34, 35, 36
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Sangre en la pradera
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Friedrich Gerstäcker, la película, ambientada íntegramente en el estado de Arkansas, cuenta el conflicto de intereses entre los habitantes de la ciudad y los colonos de las tierras circundantes, los mineros que llegaron durante la fiebre del oro, los vaqueros y los ladrones de ganado que causan problemas en la zona, y las tribus nativas de la región.

programme.title: Entre Lobos
programme.desc: Dos misioneras huyen tras presenciar un asesinato y buscan refugio con exasesinos que les ofrecen protección. Sin embargo, para sobrevivir, deberán conseguir armas, enfrentándose a un mundo peligroso donde la fe y la violencia chocan.

programme.title: El candidato
programme.desc: En un estado rural, un hombre de negocios es moldeado por un equipo de campaña para crearle una imagen que lo haga aceptable a los votantes de clase media.

programme.title: Encontrando el amor en sisters
programme.desc: Esperanza, abogada exitosa, ve su vida desmoronarse. Tras la muerte de su madre, regresa a Sisters, Oregón, y debe enfrentarse a la distancia con sus hermanas Caridad y Faith, reconsiderando familia, recuerdos y reconciliación tras años de separación.

programme.title: Soy Judio
programme.desc: Una historia apasionante donde la fe y el amor se ponen a prueba. "Soy Judío" es un proyecto cinematográfico de Andariego Films y Parabollum que explora emociones profundas y desafíos personales.

programme.title: Noches sin lunas ni soles
programme.desc: El Cairo ha pasado tres años en prisión. Cuatro meses antes de cumplir su condena, se fuga. El sheriff Maidana intenta recapturarlo.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Un equipo de bomberos del Ejército de Estados Unidos está fracturado por tensiones raciales, crisis morales y las presiones del combate en una guerra que nadie quiere pelear.

programme.title: Hijos de la medianoche
programme.desc: En la medianoche del 15 de agosto de 1947, el mismo día en que la India consiguió la independencia, Saleem y Shiva nacieron en el mismo hospital de Bombay y formaron parte de la primera generación libre del país. La historia de Saleem y Shiva, intercambiados en sus cunas al nacer, tiene como transfondo la convulsa historia de la India moderna, desde su independencia hasta los años ochenta: poderes sobrenaturales, amores prohibidos y secretos de familia se entremezclan con guerras y golpes de estado.

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: La Mujer sin Piano
programme.desc: Un ama de casa casada para la que no hay nada comparable a la íntima satisfacción de ver el plato humeante servido con admirable puntualidad a la hora de la comida. Veinticuatro horas de su vida de la que una noche decide escapar, y cuenta todo lo que le pasa en esta fuga.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: Mi gran despedida
programme.desc: Tres amores: el de Puri, dispuesta a hacer lo posible y lo imposible por dejar las cosas claras con su novio el de Milagro, que guarda más secretos de los que su naturaleza le permite, y el de Sara, cuya inminente boda reúne a un variopinto grupo de mujeres para festejar su compromiso.

programme.title: Seven Dorms of Death
programme.desc: Seven Dorms of Death tells the tale of a cursed stage play that is about to be performed at a New England college. Unfortunately for the director, the young cast, and anyone else unlucky enough to be involved with the production, someone has deadly plans for the play! Can a pair of homicide detectives and a student with psychic powers solve the mystery before it's too late'

programme.title: Hürkus
programme.desc: Vecihi Hürkus vivió entre los años 1896-1969, fue una de las figuras más importantes de la historia de la aviación turca, al ser el primer diseñador y fabricante de aviones del país. La película rememora algunos de los hechos más destacables de su vida personal y profesional.

programme.title: Amelia 2.0
programme.desc: Cuando el marido de una mujer moribunda es abordado por una corporación pionera en un nuevo programa para extender la vida a través de la robótica, quedan atrapados en un debate público sobre la relación del ser humano con la tecnología.

programme.title: Dulcinea
programme.desc: La terapeuta de Connor, un joven norteamericano, obsesionado con España, le otorga un anillo mágico con el que huir de su "realidad" y con el que es capaz de viajar a cualquier parte del mundo que desee, con una sola condición: no visitar el mismo sitio dos veces.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: La Noche nunca Duerme
programme.desc: En el transcurso de una sola noche, el sargento de Crímenes Callejeros de Nueva York Thomas Cavanaugh (Dan Brennan) y sus compañeros Rourke (Stephanie Finochio) y Jablonsky (Robert Clohessy) persiguen a los asesinos de uno de los miembros de su grupo de trabajo, buscando información entre los sórdidos habitantes de un barrio infestado de delincuencia.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Secuestrado en Rumanía
programme.desc: Dos periodistas italoamericanos han desaparecido mientras se encontraban en una misión en Rumanía.

programme.title: Vlad, el Empalador
programme.desc: Siete guerreros luchan contra Vlad “El Empalador” para salvar a su pueblo en una épica batalla final.

programme.title: Viking
programme.desc: Vladimir el Grande unifica tribus eslavas.

programme.title: El Ultimo Soldado Americano
programme.desc: Tras caer prisionero en la jungla de Vietnam, el "Comandante" consigue escapar.

programme.title: Amenaza Terrorista
programme.desc: Un agente británico debe localizar y eliminar a un terrorista suicida y a su célula nacida en el país.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: El mortífero virus T de la Corporación Umbrella se extiende por el planeta y transforma a gente común y corriente en legiones de muertos vivientes. La raza humana va camino a la extinción y tiene solo una esperanza: Alice (Milla Jovovich). Ella tiene la misión de abrirse paso por ciudades y a través de continentes, todo dentro de la instalación de investigación principal de Umbrella. Viejos amigos se convierten en nuevos enemigos mientras Alice lucha por escapar y descubre que todo lo que cree quizá no sea verdad.

programme.title: Resident Evil
programme.desc: Alice (Milla Jovovich) está de vuelta en la cuarta entrega de la saga Resident Evil. Ahora, sin poderes superhumanos, se unirá a sus compañeros supervivientes Claire y Chris (Ali Larter y Wentworth Miller) para enfrentarse a los ejércitos de los no-muertos y acabar con la Corporación Umbrella cuyo virus los ha creado.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. Un sargento de la Marina (Aaron Eckhart) y sus hombres tendrán que enfrentarse en una inesperada batalla a un enemigo absolutamente desconocido.

programme.title: Invasión A La Tierra
programme.desc: Durante muchos años ha habido casos documentados sobre testigos que han visto OVNIS en todo el mundo.Pero lo que hasta ese momento eran simples avistamientos, en 2011 se convierte en una terrible realidad cuando la Tierra es atacada por fuerzas desconocidas.Una tras otra van cayendo las grandes ciudades del mundo, y Los Ángeles se ha convertido en el último bastión de la humanidad. programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: Las ocho montañas
programme.desc: Pietro es un chico de ciudad. Todos los años pasa el verano con su familia en el pueblo de Bruno, el último niño de una localidad de montaña olvidada. Con el paso de los años, Bruno se mantiene fiel a su montaña, mientras que Pietro viene y va.

programme.title: Bravetown
programme.desc: Josh es un alma sin rumbo con un talento musical extraordinario que se embarca en un viaje para encontrar lo que menos esperaba, pero que, sin duda alguna, más necesitaba.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente II
programme.desc: Joshua McCord, veterano de las fuerzas especiales y guardaespaldas del presidente de los Estados Unidos, recibe una importante misión confiada directamente por el presidente.
